layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0E17]/60 border border-white/5 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-2xl p-8

rosary_visualization.description: A circular or elliptical layout of 50 small beads (Hail Mary) grouped in 5 decades, separated by slightly larger beads (Our Father). The current active bead glows.

prayer_card.classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border border-[#D4AF37]/20 rounded-2xl p-8 sm:p-12 min-h-[300px] flex flex-col justify-center items-center relative overflow-hidden
prayer_card.text_classes: text-[#F8F3E6] font-serif text-xl sm:text-2xl leading-relaxed text-center

controls.description: Floating action buttons for Music Toggle, Restart, and Settings/Info.
controls.button_style: text-[#A1A7B3] hover:text-[#D4AF37] transition-colors p-3 rounded-full hover:bg-white/5

progress_indicator.description: Subtle text showing e.g. 'Misterio 1 de 5 - Cuenta 3 de 10'
progress_indicator.classes: text-sm text-[#D4AF37] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans mb-4

keyboard.Enter: Advance to the next step/prayer in the sequence.

testing.data_testid_requirements: All interactive elements, including the audio toggle, next button (if present for mobile), bead elements, and current prayer text container must have a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
